narrative: The tech landscape is currently dominated by the rapid expansion and mixed reception of AI, from its application in financial trading and content creation to growing public skepticism and law enforcement concerns about 'anti-tech extremism'. Simultaneously, space agencies like NASA are pushing forward with ambitious lunar missions and student challenges, while issues of digital privacy and major product updates continue to shape the consumer tech and developer spheres.

highlights.title: AI coding startup Cognition raises $1B at $25B pre-money valuation
highlights.whyItMatters: This significant funding round highlights massive investor confidence and rapid growth in AI development, particularly in specialized areas like AI coding.

highlights.title: DuckDuckGo search saw 28% more visits after Google said people love AI mode
highlights.whyItMatters: This increase in DuckDuckGo usage suggests a notable public preference for AI-free search alternatives following Google's integration of AI, highlighting user concerns about AI's impact on search experience.

highlights.title: NASA to Announce Artemis III Crew, Provide Mission Progress Update
highlights.whyItMatters: This announcement marks a critical step forward in NASA's ambitious human lunar exploration program, signaling imminent crew selection and mission advancements.

highlights.title: Motorola says affiliate hijacking of Amazon app was ‘unintended’
highlights.whyItMatters: The incident raises significant concerns about mobile device security and trust, even with major manufacturers, emphasizing the need for robust protections against unwanted affiliate tracking.

highlights.title: Robinhood will let your AI agent trade stocks and make (or lose) lots of money
highlights.whyItMatters: This move by Robinhood integrates AI directly into personal finance and trading, representing a significant shift towards autonomous financial management and posing new risks and opportunities for investors.

highlights.title: YouTube will now automatically label AI videos
highlights.whyItMatters: This policy change from YouTube is a major step towards enhancing transparency and combating misinformation by automatically identifying AI-generated content, rather than solely relying on creators.

highlights.title: UK Visa Portal spilled thousands of applicants’ passports and selfies online — and hasn’t fixed the leak
highlights.whyItMatters: This severe data breach exposes highly sensitive personal information, highlighting critical security failures in government-related services and the potential for long-term identity theft risks.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI)

It also touches on concerns like AI psychosis and 'anti-tech extremism'.

topics.name: Space Exploration & Technology
topics.summary: Focuses on ongoing efforts in lunar missions, rocket development, Earth observation, and general space science by NASA and SpaceX, highlighting both progress and challenges in space technology and exploration initiatives.
